pretreatments.description: lab-scale shredding operation (I-PT): low-speed knife mill reducing particle size of larger fibers (>20 mm) into smaller ones (10-20 mm) without changing overall structure significantly.
lab-scale shredding and mixing operation (II-PT): pulping operation with 10:1 water/TS ratio favoring organic compound extraction into the liquid phase.
lab-scale shredding, mixing and blending operation (III-PT): fine blending operation simulating industrial wet grinders to alter lignocellulosic structure and create homogeneous liquid slurry.
full-scale mobile hammer mill (HM3): Noremat Valormax BA915D on cattle manure (M3).
full-scale fixed hammer mill (HM4): on-line fixed hammer mill on cattle manure (M4).
full-scale X-Chopper chain mill (CH-SM): Xergi on mixture of silage and cattle manure (SM).
